note: A model built as an encoder feeding a decoder: seq2seq text, speech and vision-language models, plus encoder-decoder nets such as U-Net.

answers.q: Every task is text in, text out, even classification. The C4 corpus was built for it.
A BERT-style encoder bolted to a GPT-style decoder, trained to repair corrupted text.
Vaswani et al. 2017 was a translation model first: six encoder layers, six decoder layers.
Log-mel in, tokens out: a plain encoder-decoder trained on 680,000 hours of weakly labelled audio.

aka: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
answers.q: Sutskever et al. 2014: read the sentence with one LSTM, write the translation with another. Reversing the input helped.
T5 instruction-tuned on 1.8K tasks. Still the pick when you need a small model that follows instructions.

aka: Pre-training with Extracted Gap-sentences for Abstractive Summarization
answers.q: Pre-trained by masking whole sentences and regenerating them. Tailor-made for summarisation.
Swin encoder, BART-style decoder: reads a document image and writes out structured JSON. No OCR engine anywhere.
Helsinki's OPUS-MT checkpoints: the quick-and-cheap translator on Hugging Face, one per language pair.
No Language Left Behind: 200 languages, many with almost no web text.
Eight LSTM layers each side plus attention: the 2016 rebuild that moved Google Translate to neural.

aka: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
answers.q: Where attention began: a bidirectional encoder and a decoder that learns to align as it translates.
A convolutional encoder, a decoder, and skip connections between matching levels. Born for biomedical segmentation.
The encoder-decoder that is asked to reproduce its own input through a bottleneck.
A CNN backbone, a transformer encoder, and a decoder that turns N learned queries straight into boxes.

aka: Show and Tell: A Neural Image Caption Generator
answers.q: A CNN encoder and an LSTM decoder: the 2015 template for image captioning.
Characters in, mel spectrogram out: attention-based seq2seq for TTS, with a WaveNet vocoder on the end.
T5 with no tokenizer: it reads raw UTF-8 bytes.
BART with Longformer attention in the encoder, so it can summarise 16K-token documents.
One shared encoder-decoder for ASR, TTS and speech translation, with modal pre- and post-nets.
An image Transformer encoder reading a line of text and a text Transformer decoder writing it out.
A ViT feeding an mT5-style encoder-decoder.
One Transformer encoder-decoder, every task (captioning, VQA, grounding) cast as sequence generation.
T5 fine-tuned on dozens of prompted tasks to see whether it generalises to unseen ones. It does.

aka: Massively Multilingual and Multimodal Machine Translation

answers.q: Whisper with the decoder cut down to two layers, distilled from the original. Several times faster.
NVIDIA's FastConformer encoder plus Transformer decoder for ASR and translation.
A tiny speech recogniser built for live transcription on cheap hardware. No mel step: a convolutional stem reads raw audio.

aka: Show, Attend and Tell: Neural Image Caption Generation with Visual Attention
answers.q: Show and Tell with a soft-attention decoder that looks at different image regions for each word.
Translates directly between any pair of 100 languages, no English pivot required.
Facebook's 2017 all-convolution translator: gated linear units, no recurrence, multi-step attention.
A summariser that can copy words from the source through a pointer or generate new ones, switching with a soft gate.
The 2015 speech recogniser: a pyramidal-LSTM listener, an attention-based speller.

aka: Effective Approaches to Attention-based Neural Machine Translation

answers.q: Google's first attention-based seq2seq model that goes straight from characters to spectrograms.
Gemma decoder weights re-used to initialise an encoder-decoder, so a 9B encoder can pair with a 2B decoder.
A DaViT image encoder and a Transformer encoder-decoder that writes boxes, masks and captions as text.
Decoder upsamples using the encoder's max-pooling indices instead of learning to upsample.
DeepLabv3 as the encoder, plus a small decoder to sharpen the object boundaries.

aka: RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder
answers.q: The 2014 paper that invented the GRU as a side effect of building this translation encoder-decoder.
T5 with some FFNs turned into mixtures of experts, each token routed to exactly one expert.
Transformer encoder-decoder whose layers are shared and applied repeatedly, with adaptive computation time.
A hierarchical Transformer encoder with a decoder that is just an MLP.

aka: MASS: Masked Sequence to Sequence Pre-training for Language Generation
answers.q: Microsoft's 2019 pre-training: mask a span in the encoder, make the decoder predict only that span.
A decoder that predicts the next n tokens at once, which forces it to plan ahead.
BART for French.
BART for Vietnamese.
A T5 pre-trained on a small corpus of African languages, to test how far small data goes.
mT5 retrained with UniMax sampling, which stops the big languages swamping the small ones.
An mT5-XXL instruction-tuned across 101 languages by Cohere For AI.
Google's T5-style translator trained on a manually audited, 419-language CommonCrawl corpus.
AI4Bharat's translator covering all 22 scheduled Indian languages.
BART pre-trained on Java, Python and Stack Overflow text.
CodeT5 whose encoder and decoder can be used alone or together, depending on the task.
DeepMind's competitive-programming model: an encoder reads the problem, a decoder samples up to a million programs.
Translates between C++, Java and Python with no parallel data: monolingual pre-training, denoising and back-translation.

aka: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain QA
answers.q: A T5 that encodes each retrieved passage separately and fuses them all in the decoder's cross-attention.
A retrieval-augmented T5 that learns its retriever and reader jointly. Few-shot QA with 11B parameters.
Original spelling: docTTTTTquery. A T5 that predicts queries for each document, which are appended before indexing.

aka: Document Ranking with a Pretrained Sequence-to-Sequence Model
answers.q: A reranker that generates the word "true" or "false" for a query and a document.

aka: Transformer Memory as a Differentiable Search Index
answers.q: A T5 trained to map the query straight to the document ID. The index is the model weights.
Amazon's forecaster: scale and quantise a time series into tokens, then let a T5-style model predict the next ones.
A T5 that translates between a molecule's SMILES string and a plain-English description.
A T5 trained on protein sequences. Its encoder alone is a popular protein embedder.
A seq2seq Transformer that treats chemical reactions as translation: reactants in, products out.

aka: Stable and Transferable Mixture of Experts
Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models

answers.q: Amazon's 20B seq2seq model: state of the art at 1-shot translation on Flores-101, despite being far smaller than GPT-3.
Google's 2020 chatbot: an Evolved Transformer with one encoder block and thirteen decoder blocks.

aka: Recipes for building an open-domain chatbot
answers.q: Facebook's 2020 open-domain chatbot: a seq2seq Transformer scaled up to 9.4B parameters.
Google's direct speech-to-speech translator: spectrogram in, spectrogram out, no intermediate text.
Whisper's recipe rebuilt on public data only, with an E-Branchformer encoder in v3.1.

aka: Speech-Transformer: A No-Recurrence Sequence-to-Sequence Model for Speech Recognition
answers.q: A 2018 ASR Transformer: 2D attention over the spectrogram, no recurrence anywhere.

aka: Neural Speech Synthesis with Transformer Network
answers.q: Tacotron 2 with the recurrence replaced by Transformer layers, so training parallelises.
A ViT encoder and text decoder pre-trained to turn web-page screenshots into simplified HTML.
Pix2Struct fine-tuned to turn a chart into a table, so an LLM can then reason over the numbers.

aka: MatCha math reasoning and chart derendering
Neural Optical Understanding for Academic Documents
answers.q: Meta's Donut-style model that reads a scientific PDF page as an image and writes markup, equations included.

aka: Unifying Vision, Text, and Layout for Universal Document Processing
answers.q: A T5-large encoder-decoder with layout coordinates treated as extra text tokens.
Dense video captioning where the output tokens include timestamps, so one T5-style decoder writes captions and times.

aka: Pix2Seq: A Language Modeling Framework for Object Detection
answers.q: Object detection as language modelling: boxes become discrete tokens written out in a sequence.
One T5-style encoder-decoder for images, text, boxes and masks, all tokenised as sequences.
A vision-language encoder-decoder trained with just one objective: prefix language modelling.

aka: Unifying Vision-and-Language Tasks via Text Generation
answers.q: T5 with image region features fed to the encoder, so VQA and captioning become text generation.

aka: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Content-Rich Text-to-Image Generation
answers.q: Google's text-to-image as machine translation: text tokens in, ViT-VQGAN image tokens out. Scaled to 20B.

aka: Perceiver IO: A General Architecture for Structured Inputs & Outputs
answers.q: Encodes any input into a small latent array, then a decoder queries it with whatever output shape you want.

aka: Neural Machine Translation in Linear Time
answers.q: 2016 dilated-convolution translator with running time linear in the sequence length.
A dialogue model with an encoder over each utterance and a second recurrent network over the conversation.

aka: A Neural Representation of Sketch Drawings
answers.q: A sequence-to-sequence VAE that learns to draw pen strokes. The encoder is bidirectional, the decoder emits stroke offsets.
A Transformer cell found by evolutionary architecture search, seeded with the original.
A deep but light Transformer that matches the baseline with far fewer parameters.

aka: Pay Less Attention with Lightweight and Dynamic Convolutions
answers.q: 2019 translators that replace self-attention with convolutions. The dynamic version predicts its kernel from the current token.
Non-autoregressive translation by repeatedly inserting and deleting tokens, instead of writing left to right.

aka: Insertion Transformer: Flexible Sequence Generation via Insertion Operations
answers.q: Generates by inserting tokens anywhere in a partial sequence, not left to right.

aka: Mask-Predict: Parallel Decoding of Conditional Masked Language Models
answers.q: Predict every target word at once, mask the least confident, repeat. A few passes beat left to right.
Gu et al. 2018: emit the whole translation in parallel, using fertility to predict how many times each source word is copied.

aka: Leveraging Pre-trained Checkpoints for Sequence Generation Tasks
answers.q: Two BERT checkpoints stitched into an encoder-decoder, with fresh cross-attention in the decoder.
A CNN plus Transformer encoder, with a U-Net decoder for medical segmentation.
A ViT encoder with a U-Net-style CNN decoder, for 3D medical volumes.

aka: Volumetric Convolutional Neural Networks for Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation
answers.q: A 3D U-Net cousin with residual blocks that introduced the Dice loss for volumetric segmentation.
Kalchbrenner and Blunsom 2013: an early neural translator with a convolutional encoder and a recurrent decoder.

aka: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
Learning Deconvolution Network for Semantic Segmentation
Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks
